title: Folders
description: This mod allows you to make a portable storage folder that you can carry anywhere and store it inside a chest!
body:
**Folders** lets you create a folder (yes, **a folder**) where you can place your stuff inside and carry it anywhere you want. You can also rename it using an anvil so you don't forget what's inside. And unlike a computer, Making a duplicate won't name it "**Folder (1)**"!

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11f4f4a23c1e153444e95d976b29383284c15d71.png)

Thank you for paying attention to this mod
